استعييت (form X)
# اِسْتَعْيَيْتُ (istaʕyaytu) /is.taʕ.jaj.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِسْتَعْيَا (istaʕyā)
# اِسْتَعْيَيْتَ (istaʕyayta) /is.taʕ.jaj.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِسْتَعْيَا (istaʕyā)
# اِسْتَعْيَيْتِ (istaʕyayti) /is.taʕ.jaj.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِسْتَعْيَا (istaʕyā)
